focus: Core relaunch state machine and process-targeting seams
noveltyJustification: All five defects are new to this packet and none was covered by the phase 005-008 findings.

label: Claude stop hook resolves the killer target as process.ppid when CLAUDE_PID is unset, which is the transient bash -c hook wrapper rather than the Claude process; the record stays armed and the session is never ended.

resolveWindow reads Claude settings only under the session cwd, so a session started in a repo subdirectory misses the 500000-token autoCompactWindow and uses the 200000 default, doubling the fill ratio.
shouldRelaunch approves an armed record without checking handoff or cwd, and the wrapper then exits 1 instead of declining and preserving the runtime exit code.
parseHandoff accepts whitespace before a frontmatter colon while updateFrontmatter does not, so claim duplicates the key and the next parse throws duplicate frontmatter key.
consume's malformed-note fallback marks spec_folder: none as invalid, dropping a valid Gate 3 D Skip answer when the note has another parse defect.
